Title: Consultancy for supporting Karnali PA for Public Hearing, Oversight, and Promoting Open Parliamentary Practices
Department/Unit: Parliament Support Project
Reports to: National Project Manager
Coordination with: Project Team Lead
Implementation Area: Provincial Assembly
Expected Places of Travel (if applicable): NA
Duration of Assignment: 01 June to 30 August
Provision of support services:
Office space Yes □ No x
Equipment (laptop etc.) Yes □ No x
Secretarial Services Yes □ No x



2. Background Information


Since 2018, UNDP through parliament support (PSP) project is supporting the parliaments and secretariats in PAs to strengthen their capacities for effective operation of parliamentary functions including institutional capacity building. PSP’s support to the PAs are focused primarily towards strengthening parliamentary core functions; oversight, law making, and enhancing the representation. PSP, over the years has invested in the parliament outreach and openness through various initiation such as: introducing Meet the Speaker in Karnali and Sudurpaschim Provinces, connecting the PAs with the District through virtual mode, development of Outreach plan of action, supporting the parliaments for the public hearing through the media and CSOs to count few.
Some of the initiations of previous years have been adopted by the PA secretariats in some ways however, there are still many areas where the Parliament secretariat has limited engagement such as engaging with the public and thematic independent CSOs in the oversight of pertinent issues. Though there are examples of some openness activities initiated by the PA secretariat, but these are not always consistent. Likewise, the engagement with the citizens through public hearing and open interaction is another aspect through which the parliament Secretariat can enhance their outreach and openness where the secretariat will get the opportunities to respond to the queries from the citizen while sharing about the activities of the Parliament secretariat. Planning and organizing an event where citizen forums could be engaged through the consultation, dialogues, sharing, and other side activities could be another method of promoting parliament openness by engaging with the public, youth, and students in larger scale.
Additionally, engaging with the CSOs for supporting the parliament secretariat in planning and organizing the events related to the parliamentary openness not only help the secretariat in swift management but it will also contribute towards wider stakeholder engagement in the parliamentary affairs and better understanding and awareness on the overall legislative development and oversight mechanism.
In this backdrop, PSP plans to engage with a competent service provider organization to support the Karnali PA secretariat in the oversight on relevant emerging issues, including the public hearing and a mega event on the parliamentary openness. Through these programs the PA secretariats are expected to enhance their collaboration with the relevant CSOs and experts while also inspiring the PA towards making the parliament more open and accessible to the public.
Thus the project plans to hire service from a consulting firm/organisation that can provide the service as per the scope of this ToR.


3. Objectives of Assignment

The overall objective of the proposed assignment is:
To conduct dialogues/interaction through public hearing to make parliament accountable to the citizens
To support the PA committees in their oversight works to engage with relevant thematic CSOs.
To support the PA secretariat in planning and organizing a package event as part of the parliamentary openness


4. Scope of work Expected Results/Deliverables/Final Products Expected
The service provider will work in close coordination with the Project to complete the following duties and responsibilities.
Scope of Work:
The service provider will establish coordination with the PSP, PA secretariat and relevant stakeholders to to facilitate the said activities relating to conducting 2 public hearing, 2 events with Committees on their oversight work, and conduct one package-based Event for Parliamentary Openness in Karnali Province.
In addition, the service provider will accomplish the following:
Planning and Implementation
Activity1: Support PA to Conduct Public Hearing-2 events
Service provider will identify key issues and develop a plan for the public hearing
Coordinate with the PA secretariat, relevant thematic committees for planning and organization
Identify the key issues and venue for public hearing with the Committee on various issues within its jurisdiction, and it will be done in consultation with the Committee secretariat and PSP.
Collect pertinent questions and concerns form the selected community on the issue in advance so that it could be raised during the hearing programme.
Research some evidence on the key issues of the community so that the moderator could help the community raise/complement their concerns.
Select the Chairs/MPs (at least 4) representing at least 2 thematic committees of the PA and at least one MP from that constituency.
Select a spot related to selected issues that must be accessible and feasible for a one-day event.
Organize and facilitate2 events of public hearing program between the parliamentarians of the PA of the Province and the citizens on the selected issue.
The interaction will take place at the community level which is accessible in terms of proximity from the provincial capital.
Make sure that media persons are also engaged in the event and the news of the same is covered by the local media.
Prepare a detailed report with the major issues raised, response/commitment made, and ways forward.

Activity 2: Support PA secretariat to engage with Research institutions and CSOs in oversight work-2 events
Service provider will prepare plan of engagement with the CSOs
Coordination with PA Secretariat, committees and relevant CSOs for the engagement in committees works
Conduct a half day interaction/ sharing event among the PA secretariat, Committees and lead representative from the CSOs to inform the committees on their thematic areas of engagement, and sensitize to identify the pertinent areas for the oversight.
Facilitate evidence-based presentations from the CSOs so that committees could make informed choices about their oversight agenda.
Such engagement could be with different committees such as women and social dev committees with focus on women and social justice, Public Accounts Committee with CSOs and media active on public financial governance , Agriculture and Environment committee with the CSOs working on Environment, Climate and forestry etc.)
Document the major discussion, way forward and future engagement plan, if any
Provide the committees with the roster of the CSOs/research institutions for the use of the committees

Activity 3: Support PA secretariat to promote open parliamentary practices-1 packaged event
Service provider will develop an event plan to organize the event for promoting the parliamentary openness.
Coordinate and share with the Parliament Secretariat, leadership, and PSP the event plan and finalizee event accordingly.
Organize a package-based event on parliament openness in the PA in consultation with the PA secretariat ( the openness event could be a good mix of at least 5 activities such as Visit Your Parliament visit, documentary show, photo or video shows, exhibition on democracy and parliaments/ quiz or elocution shows/Meet the Speaker for elderly citizen, Youths/Students Q and A with MPs, Know your Lawmaking Corner, Women and Marginalized Groups in Parliament Corner, and other talk series relating to parliament openness or any other events as identified in consultation with the PA secretariat )
Engage at least 250 people directly in these activities and reach out t at least 10 thousand people via social media tools
Prepare event report on major achievements, outreach, and outcome of the program

Methodology:
The Service provider will be responsible for all the logistics associated with organizing and conducting the said events/activities.
The public hearing program will be more participative, interactive, and practical where all the stakeholders will be given the chance to share their queries unopposed.
The moderation of the public hearing program will be managed by a moderator to bind the program in a standard format and save the time
The event on the engagement with the CSOs/Research Institutions will be expert led for the better understanding of Parliamentarians followed by a moderated open discussion.
The eservice provider must mobilize an independent expert with exemplary expertise and experience in parliamentary affairs, oversight issues and collaboration who can share his/her findings without any prejudice.
The parliament openness event will be planned based on the discussion and agreement with the PA secretariat and in consultation with PSP.
The service provider will ensure all public communication via relevant media to invite the public and engage the partners such as university and media, and disseminate the programme and so on.
The service provider must document all the events and its output/outcome appropriately along with the report, pictures, and videos.
Points of Consideration for the service Provider
The service provider must coordinate with the PA secretariat appropriately for the participative program planning and to ensure the engagement of the PA secretariat in every step of program implementation.
The service provider should have to be flexible enough to plan the events as per the availability of the Parliament and Committee leadership
The service provider team /moderator should avoid any issues/ discussion that may cause political conflict during the events.
The service provider must ensure the Gender balanced participation in each event.
Report Submission
Prepare and submit the event completion report with a precise Executive summary followed by activity wise chapters (1 chapter for Public hearing, one for Engagement with the CSOs in Oversight, and one on Openness event) . The Report will include key achievements and observations, points of discussion, key anecdotes/remarks of the participants, parliamentarians, lessons learnt, ways forward, and necessary annexes relating thereof to UNDP/PSP.

Time Frame:
The time frame for the completion of the assignment is within 01 June 30 August 2023

Expected Results/Final Products/Deliverables:
Completion of 2 public hearing events on key issue with the parliament and Committee leadership in the Karnali Province where at least 100 public (including some from LGBTIQ and Persons with Disabilities groups) interact with the committee leadership.
Completion of 2 events with the CSOs/Research Institution on parliamentary Oversight where 10 -15 thematic CSOs will get the opportunity to discuss about the issues with Committee leadership as stated above.
Completion of 1 packaged event on promoting the parliamentary openness where at least 250 public get the opportunity to directly participate and reach out to at least 10 thousand people via social media tools
A report based on the findings and outcomes of these 3 events and possible ways forward.
Good photos and a small (2-3minutes) video featuring the summary of all three events and feedbacks of the participants.

 public string Title { set { _title = value; NotifyPropertyChanged();}

import time

from urllib.request import urlopen, Request
 
setting the URL you want to monitor
url = Request('https://leetcode.com/',
              headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
 
to perform a GET request and load the
content of the website and store it in a var
response = urlopen(url).read()
 
to create the initial hash
currentHash = hashlib.sha224(response).hexdigest()
print("running")
time.sleep(10)
while True:
    try:
        # perform the get request and store it in a var
        response = urlopen(url).read()
 
        # create a hash
        currentHash = hashlib.sha224(response).hexdigest()
 
        # wait for 30 seconds
        time.sleep(30)
 
        # perform the get request
        response = urlopen(url).read()
 
        # create a new hash
        newHash = hashlib.sha224(response).hexdigest()
 
        # check if new hash is same as the previous hash
        if newHash == currentHash:
            continue
 
        # if something changed in the hashes
        else:
            # notify
            print("something changed")
 
            # again read the website
            response = urlopen(url).read()
 
            # create a hash
            currentHash = hashlib.sha224(response).hexdigest()
 
            # wait for 30 seconds
            time.sleep(30)
            continue
 
    # To handle exceptions
    except Exception as e:
        print("error")

目覚め

　僕はネットワークセキュリティエンジニアとして働いていた。壮年となるいまでも独身だがモテないわけではない。異性に嫌われないようにするために、清潔感とか相手への気遣いって言うのは大事である。とは言っても、仕事柄結婚する気はなかった、いつ死ぬかわからない仕事だったからだ。それに相手に深入りすることは許されない仕事でもあった。そして突然死を迎えることになった。





　仕事をしていても同僚は物理的には近くにいない。ネットでつながっているだけだ。”防衛上の機密”のため、同僚がどういう人かも知らない。この部屋に住み、ひたすらこの国を守っている。

　僕の仕事はいわゆる「ハッキング」からの防衛だ。ネットワークに侵入して情報を盗んだり、ウイルスをばらまいたりして攻撃するヤツラからこの国を守ることだった。自慢させてもらうとこの国や世界でもトップクラスだと自負している。ただ、その存在自体が秘匿されていて、いくつかの国に”コードネーム”が割り当てられていると言うことだけは知っていた。

　”ネームド”これはその成果を誇りに思っていい。反面、狙われる危険もそれだけ大きくなる。そしてよく狙われた。

　

　ネットワークでの負けは死につながることもある。僕自身への攻撃はすべて一蹴した。逆に容赦のない報復も行ったことも多く、上司からやりすぎと何度も忠告を受けている。しかし、そんなことはどうでもよかった。僕の命はこの国のものだし、国民を守ることが最優先事項だからだ。それに敵に容赦することは自分への危険を増やすことにもなる。多くの仲間が死んでいった。おそらくこの年齢まで生きている”軍人セキュリティエンジニア”というのは僕ぐらいのものだとだと思っている。

　先輩は皆いなくなったし、後輩も10年続いた人間はいなかった。



　ある日のこと、いつものように仕事をしていた。この日も特に問題なく終わると思っていた。いつも通りに侵入者を発見し、罠にかけ追い詰めていた。完璧にこなしていたがなにか嫌な予感がする。こういう時は必ずなにかがある。指導してくれた先輩、親しくなった名も性別も知らない仲間、後輩が消えたときもそうだった。



　その時爆発音がした。攻撃？　まさか、ありえない。この場所はしっかり秘匿されている。また我々もプライドがあって、物理攻撃はあり得なかった。しかし、その後の銃声から実際に攻撃されているのがわかった。敵だ。



「くそっ！　どいつだ！」

　我慢しきれなかったどこかの国が強硬手段に出たのだろう。僕の居場所は”秘匿されている”そのため、目立たぬよう護衛の数も20人も満たない。優秀であるが、最精鋭ではない、最精鋭は最精鋭でしか行えない特別な任務に就いている。例えば、ネットではどうしても太刀打ちできない”軍人セキュリティエンジニア”を殺すような任務だ。

　僕を攻撃しているやつらもそういう最精鋭だろう。いつでも死を覚悟していたが、自分の戦場、ネットワークでの戦い以外で命を落とすのは心残りだった。



　そんな考えが浮かんでいる間にすべての音が止んだ。僕の命もあと数秒だろう。今までの人生が走馬灯のように走る。辛かったのは結婚を約束した女性と別れたときだった。心を繋げるのは機密を漏らすことになる。一般の軍人は相手も納得の上だが、外では僕は軍人であることも秘匿していた。



　結果として彼女と別れ、体を合わすだけの関係を続けていた。今付き合っている複数の女性も居るし、口説き中の女性も居る。それがすべて中断するのは無念だった。

（死の間際にヤリのこした事って、コレか？）

　結局国を守る誇りといいながら”牡”としての欲望だけが最後の瞬間に考えることか！　と自嘲しているとドアが開いて銃口が見えた。光も音も、痛みすら感じずに意識がなくなった。



　◆◆◆



　一瞬か永遠か？消えたはずの僕の意識がはっきりし始めた。絶対に死ぬという状況で生きていたことは信じられなかった。まず見えたのは白い天井だった。パイプベットに真っ白な布団、医療機器の音が聞こえる。間違いなく病院のベットの上だった。

「ああ、、神様ありがとうございます」

　女性の声が聞こえた、そこを向くと、やつれているが僕好みの女性の顔が見えた。



「お母さん」

　と言う言葉が出てきた。え？　年下だろ？　知らない女性にそんなこと言ったら殴られるぞ。しかし、彼女は涙を流しながら喜んでいるようだった。

「悠真、よかった、本当に良かった」



　”悠真”。その名前を聞いてから、徐々に別人の記憶が流れ込んで来る。悠真という少年の記憶だった。中学生の少年の記憶、目の前に猛スピードの車が突っ込んできたのが最後の記憶だった。その時死んだと思った少年の魂は昇華した。そして抜け殻だけが残った。その少年の身体に僕の魂が入っていったようだった。

　母、医師、そして看護師他接する人たちからわかったのは、実は自分の世界と似ている異世界の少年の身体に入り込んだということだった。



　それからはずっと検査やらなんやらでずっと病室に閉じこもっていた。なにしろ、長い間意識不明の状態だったから身体が思うように動かない。身長は170を大きく超えて、やや大柄なはずなのに、体重は骨と皮の分しかなかった。10代半ばという体力が充実している時期のはずが立つことも難しかった。とにかく状況がわからないので、悠真という少年のフリをすることに決めた。記憶は徐々に流れて込んでくるが不足していることも多い。それは後遺症と思われているのは幸いだった。



　あと、母親のことを以前のように”お母さん”と呼べずに”千早都（ちさと）ママ”と呼んでいる。血のつながった母と完全には思えなかったからだ。以前から”ママ”と呼んで欲しかった彼女は喜んでいたが、半分と少しは”夜のお店のママ”の気持ちで呼んでいた。ようするに”女性”として見ている、とういうことだ。目を覚ましてからだんだんと慣れていったが最初は本当に年下の女性としか思えず、到底お母さんとは呼べなかった。



　退院するまで、毎日訪ねてくる母の心のケアをしながら、この世界の事を調べるていた。僕は前の世界にはなかったスマホとパソコンを母に買ってもらって病室で過ごしていた。訪ねてくるのは母の他にはいない。目を覚ます前は事故当時つきあっていた彼女が時折見舞いに来ていたそうだが、なぜか目を覚ましてからは一度も来ていない。

　そして、この悠真という少年の記憶もほぼ完全に取り戻していた。

　それらからこの世界の文化と文明を理解していった。

　

　この世界にはココロがネットワークに繋がっていない。ココロに侵入されたら自由に操られてしまう。そういう無防備な人ばかりの世界だった。だからといって悪い事をする気はなかった、周りの人には感謝の気持ちから、悪いことは一切行わず、体の調子が良くなるように配慮した。特に大切な母はその健康と美しさを取り戻すようにと丁寧にケアしていった。

　前の世界の常識では、ココロの持ち方で体も変わっていく。同じ遺伝子の構造でもその生物としての範囲ないで変えることができる。

　どこまで、どんな風に変えるか？　それはその人の腕による。そして、僕は世界でも五指にはいる腕前だった。

　その力を使ってケアした結果本当に母は元気を取り戻していった。



　僕の方はというと、リハビリは苦しくなかった。自分の肉体を変えていけば、リハビリなど余裕だった。しかし、前世での最後の思い、牡としての欲望、”ヤリたいこと、ヤリ残していたこと”が僕を苦しめていた。

　そういう我慢を続けていって、ようやく退院の日を迎えた。

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 输入数据
pm_hours = np.arange(1, 12+1)  # p.m.时间
pm_temps = np.array([66, 66, 65, 64, 63, 63, 62, 61, 60, 60, 59, 58])  # p.m.温度
am_hours = np.arange(1, 11+1)  # a.m.时间
am_temps = np.array([58, 58, 58, 58, 57, 57, 57, 58, 60, 64, 67, 68])  # a.m.温度

# 拼接数据
hours = np.concatenate([pm_hours, am_hours])
temps = np.concatenate([pm_temps, am_temps])

# 构造矩阵A和向量b
A = np.ones([24, 4])
for i in range(24):
    A[i][1] = hours[i]
    A[i][2] = hours[i] ** 2
    A[i][3] = hours[i] ** 3
b = temps.reshape([24, 1])

# 计算最小二乘解
ATA = np.dot(A.T, A)
ATb = np.dot(A.T, b)
x = np.linalg.solve(ATA, ATb)

# 打印拟合结果
print('拟合结果为 y = {:.2f} + {:.2f}x + {:.2f}x^2 + {:.2f}x^3'.format(
    x[0][0], x[1][0], x[2][0], x[3][0]))

# 绘制曲线
hours_for_plot = np.linspace(1, 11+12/24, 100)  # 生成绘图用的时间序列
temps_for_plot = x[0][0] + x[1][0]*hours_for_plot + x[2][0] * \
    hours_for_plot**2 + x[3][0]*hours_for_plot**3  # 计算拟合值
for i in range(24):
    if i < 12:
        c = 'r'  # 红色表示p.m.时间
    else:
        c = 'b'  # 蓝色表示a.m.时间
    plt.plot(hours[i], temps[i], 'o', color='c')  # 绘制原始数据点
plt.plot(hours_for_plot, temps_for_plot, color='g')  # 绘制拟合曲线
plt.xlabel('Hours')
plt.ylabel('Temperature')
plt.show()
plt.savefig('zuixiaoercheng1.png')

[player]: “Uh…hi-”

(I was shocked at what she said. But I was also confused as to why she looked like she was going to a beach.)

[player]: “Excuse me, but what’s with the clothes? Are you going swimming or-”

Female Blaze: “They’re not for swimming, dummy.”

(I stepped back in shock.)

[player]: “Okay, okay, sorry. So what are you doing here?”

Female Blaze: “I’m gathering Nether Wart. What’s it to you?”

[player]: “Oh, nothing. I was just exploring the Nether. I’ve heard there’s some pretty cool stuff here.”

(The female Blaze rolled her eyes.)

Female Blaze: “Yeah, cool stuff like getting killed by ghasts and blazes. Have fun with that.”

[player]: “I need answers, miss Blaze.”

(The female Blaze rolled her eyes again.)

Female Blaze: “I don’t have time for your stupid questions. And don’t even think about trying to talk me out of it, you disgusting pile of flesh.”

(Now I was seriously offended. I pulled out my Shield, Enchanted Netherite Sword, and Enchanted Netherite Armor Set.)

近年来，随着我国经济的持续快速发展，公路交通运输事业取得了重大成就，为了不断完善我国的公路交通运输路网结构，高等级公路的建设所面临的地形与环境条件越来越多元化，如何做好道路路线的勘测设计教学工作，是当前亟待解决的问题。

道路勘测设计是一门实践性很强的专业课程，道路路线的选定、勘测设计程序及方法是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业、交通工程专业、土木工程专业（道桥方向）学生必须具备的重要知识。但目前的教学环境所能提供的实验场地与仪器设备无法满足大批量本科生进行全面的实践锻炼与开放教学的需要，主要原因包括：1）道路路线所经过的地形场景与环境等因素复杂，无法在教学实践中全面实施、实践；2）学校的仪器（全站仪、水准仪等）数量有限，无法保证人手一台设备，大部分工作需要分组完成，主动性较差的成员容易“搭便车”，过渡依赖组内其他成员，不利于学生实践能力的培养；3）道路为线性工程，线下实验时各小组沿路线分布，工作场地分散，教师无法同时看顾所有小组，指导难以及时到位；4）为保证道路勘测设计的实践教学质量，实验场地需要具有较大的面积，地形及环境既不能太简单，又不能过于恶劣（为了保证学生安全），线下实验场地难以满足教学要求。对于《道路勘测设计实验》这种必须在室外广泛地形与环境条件下进行的实践教学活动，线下实验教学困难重重、质量难以全面保障。

因此，本项目提出使用虚拟仿真技术，以“理论、虚拟、实践”一体化的教学方式，构建虚拟仿真软件实验平台等，结合道路勘测设计实验教学的特点，确定实验目的如下：

（1）掌握道路勘测设计的程序与实施过程。向学生提供能随时随地进行虚拟仿真的实验条件，让学生在虚拟环境中开展各种地形及环境条件下的道路勘测设计实验，熟悉道路勘测设计的整个过程与实施程序，包括：选线组、量角组、中桩组、水平组、横断组等作业小组的分组原则、工作顺序的衔接等；

（2）掌握道路勘测设计的相关理论。如：横断组需要确定路基边坡坡度、明确边坡稳定性的分析方法，水平组需要理解高程测量的相关规定与理论计算依据，以及道路纵断面设计的基本原理与应用等。

（3）弥补线下实验中的不足，积极探索线上线下教学相结合的个性化、智能化、泛在化实验教学新模式，拓展实验教学内容广度和深度，延伸实验教学时间和空间，提升实验教学质量和水平。

（4）在实验过程中，培养大学生的工程实践能力，使大学生毕业后快速适应相关设计、施工等单位的工作要求，缩短“课堂教学”与“工程实践”之间的距离，提高工科大学生的整体素养与培养质量。

Scene: Angel Grove Park

A few weeks have passed since Zack and Launch’s date and they’ve continued to spend time together. Launch has introduced Zack to her daughter Lily, and they’ve become quite close.

Zack and Launch are walking through Angel Grove Park when they hear a strange noise coming from a nearby bush. They cautiously approach it and discover a small creature trapped inside.

Launch: (gently picking up the creature) Aww, poor thing. It looks hurt.

Zack: (concerned) We should take it to Zordon. He’ll know what to do.

Launch nods, and they teleport to the Command Center immediately.

Zack: (holding up the creature) Zordon, we found this creature in the park. It looks hurt. Can you help it?

Zordon: (examining the creature) Yes, I believe I can. It appears to be a rare species of alien creature that has been hunted to near extinction. We must nurse it back to health and return it to its planet before it’s targeted again.

Launch: (curious) How did it end up on Earth?

Zordon: (grave) I’m afraid that is a mystery. But we must act quickly before it’s too late.

Zack and Launch spend the next few days helping Zordon nurse the creature back to health. They’re amazed at the technology and knowledge the Command Center possesses, and they both feel a deeper sense of commitment to helping protect the planet.

As the creature begins to recover, it starts to exhibit special abilities. It can sense danger and track down lost objects with its keen sense of smell.

Zordon explains that the creature was once highly sought after as a rare kind of hunter dog. Its special abilities were often utilized for selfish purposes. But through the kindness and care of Zack and Launch, it’s developed a deep bond with them.

Launch: (smiling at the creature) We can’t just send it back to its planet alone after all it’s been through. Can we, Zordon?

Zordon: (nodding) Indeed. You both have shown great compassion and care for this creature. Its loyalty lies with you. If you’re willing to take responsibility for it, it can stay and help you protect Angel Grove.

Zack: (smiling) We’d be honored, Zordon. And we’ll make sure it’s safe here.

Launch: (nodding in agreement) Yes. It deserves a chance to live freely, without fear.

Zordon: (pleased) Very well. As the Black Ranger and his ally, you now take on an additional responsibility. But I trust you’ll handle it with care and responsibility.

Zack and Launch leave the Command Center with the creature, feeling grateful for the trust Zordon has placed in them. They spend the next few days building a safe and comfortable home for the creature in Zack’s backyard. They name it Radar, and he quickly becomes a loyal protector and friend.

Zack and Launch continue to work together as a team, protecting Angel Grove from any threats that come their way. But now they have a new friend by their side, and they’re ready for whatever new adventures may come their way.

As they finish setting up Radar’s new home, Launch takes Zack’s hand, stopping him from putting down a bag of food on the ground.

Launch: (smiling) Zack, I just wanted to say thank you for everything. For helping me care for Radar, for being there for me and my daughter, for everything.

Zack: (smiling back) You don’t have to thank me, Launch. It’s what partners do.

As Zack leans in for a small peck on Launch’s cheek as a gesture of friendship, Launch surprises him by turning his head and kissing him on the lips, taking him by surprise.

Launch: (blushing) I’m sorry, I couldn’t help it. I just had to kiss you.

Zack: (surprised but happy) No, don’t apologize. I liked it.

Launch: (smiling) Good, because I think I’m falling for you, Zack.

Zack’s face lights up with a broad smile, knowing that what Launch feels for him is what he feels for her too.

Zack: (grinning) I’m falling for you too, Launch. You and your daughter mean a lot to me, and I want to be there for you both, always.

Launch: (smiling widely) I know you will be, Zack. And I’ll be there for you, no matter what.

As they share another kiss, the sun sets over the backyard, bringing a sense of peace and belonging to the trio. They know their lives will be full of twists and turns, but with each other by their side, they can surmount any obstacle.

The trio sit together and watch as Radar sniffs around his new home, and they realize that they’re building not just a new life together, but a new family too. A bond that can withstand the test of time and every challenge that comes their way.

(in spanish) Segundo experimento: Calibrar manómetro por presión En este segundo experimento también se busca calibrar un manómetro, pero en comparación con la medición realizada por otro instrumento al aplicar la misma presión en ambos indicadores. La presión es conseguida a través de un compresor de aire. En este caso, el instrumento que se quería calibrar era un manómetro en glicerina, la cual evita vibraciones de la aguja para una correcta lectura de la medición. Cabe destacar que a pesar de ser el instrumento a calibrar, el manómetro en glicerina era más nuevo que el utilizado como referencia, por lo que hay una posibilidad de que las mediciones realizadas con este sean más exactas. A pesar de esto, se busca comparar las presiones medidas a partir de cada manómetro y buscar los errores asociados. Para realizar la comparación es necesario realizar conversión de unidades, ya que los instrumentos indican las presiones medidas en distintas unidades. El manómetro seco está en milibar (mbar) y en pulgadas de agua (in. H2O), mientras que el manómetro en glicerina está en kilopascales (kPa) y en libras por pulgada cuadrada (psi). Con esto en consideración, las medidas obtenidas por ambos instrumentos a una misma presión fueron: Manómetro Seco Manómetro en glicerina mbar in. H2O kPa psi 270 108 25 3,6 Realizando la conversión de unidades, se pasa de milibar a kilopascales y de pulgadas de agua a libras por pulgada cuadrada. Como ambas mediciones están en las mismas unidades, entonces se debe calcular el error porcentual asociado, tomando como medida exacta o de referencia la del manómetro seco. Entonces se tiene: Manómetro Seco Manómetro en glicerina Error absoluto Error porcentual kPa psi kPa psi kPa psi % % 27 3,898 25 3,6 2 0,298 7,41 7,64 A partir de estos resultados, se puede observar que el error porcentual asociado para ambas unidades (kPa y psi) es muy similar, estableciendo una cierta concordancia entre ambos instrumentos. Con estos resultados se puede establecer que el manómetro con glicerina no está del todo calibrado con respecto al seco, aunque sus mediciones están muy cercanas al valor de referencia. Con respecto al valor real, se desconoce cuál es el más exacto, aunque para los objetivos del experimento se quiere calibrar el manómetro en glicerina con respecto al seco.

僕はネットワークセキュリティエンジニアとして働いていた。壮年となるいまでも独身だがモテないわけではない。異性に嫌われないようにするために、清潔感とか相手への気遣いって言うのは大事である。とは言っても、仕事柄結婚する気はなかった、いつ死ぬかわからない仕事だったからだ。それに相手に深入りすることは許されない仕事でもあった。そして突然死を迎えることになった。





　仕事をしていても同僚は物理的には近くにいない。ネットでつながっているだけだ。”防衛上の機密”のため、同僚がどういう人かも知らない。この部屋に住み、ひたすらこの国を守っている。

　僕の仕事はいわゆる「ハッキング」からの防衛だ。ネットワークに侵入して情報を盗んだり、ウイルスをばらまいたりして攻撃するヤツラからこの国を守ることだった。自慢させてもらうとこの国や世界でもトップクラスだと自負している。ただ、その存在自体が秘匿されていて、いくつかの国に”コードネーム”が割り当てられていると言うことだけは知っていた。

　”ネームド”これはその成果を誇りに思っていい。反面、狙われる危険もそれだけ大きくなる。そしてよく狙われた。

　

　ネットワークでの負けは死につながることもある。僕自身への攻撃はすべて一蹴した。逆に容赦のない報復も行ったことも多く、上司からやりすぎと何度も忠告を受けている。しかし、そんなことはどうでもよかった。僕の命はこの国のものだし、国民を守ることが最優先事項だからだ。それに敵に容赦することは自分への危険を増やすことにもなる。多くの仲間が死んでいった。おそらくこの年齢まで生きている”軍人セキュリティエンジニア”というのは僕ぐらいのものだとだと思っている。

　先輩は皆いなくなったし、後輩も10年続いた人間はいなかった。



　ある日のこと、いつものように仕事をしていた。この日も特に問題なく終わると思っていた。いつも通りに侵入者を発見し、罠にかけ追い詰めていた。完璧にこなしていたがなにか嫌な予感がする。こういう時は必ずなにかがある。指導してくれた先輩、親しくなった名も性別も知らない仲間、後輩が消えたときもそうだった。



　その時爆発音がした。攻撃？　まさか、ありえない。この場所はしっかり秘匿されている。また我々もプライドがあって、物理攻撃はあり得なかった。しかし、その後の銃声から実際に攻撃されているのがわかった。敵だ。



「くそっ！　どいつだ！」

　我慢しきれなかったどこかの国が強硬手段に出たのだろう。僕の居場所は”秘匿されている”そのため、目立たぬよう護衛の数も20人も満たない。優秀であるが、最精鋭ではない、最精鋭は最精鋭でしか行えない特別な任務に就いている。例えば、ネットではどうしても太刀打ちできない”軍人セキュリティエンジニア”を殺すような任務だ。

　僕を攻撃しているやつらもそういう最精鋭だろう。いつでも死を覚悟していたが、自分の戦場、ネットワークでの戦い以外で命を落とすのは心残りだった。



　そんな考えが浮かんでいる間にすべての音が止んだ。僕の命もあと数秒だろう。今までの人生が走馬灯のように走る。辛かったのは結婚を約束した女性と別れたときだった。心を繋げるのは機密を漏らすことになる。一般の軍人は相手も納得の上だが、外では僕は軍人であることも秘匿していた。



　結果として彼女と別れ、体を合わすだけの関係を続けていた。今付き合っている複数の女性も居るし、口説き中の女性も居る。それがすべて中断するのは無念だった。

（死の間際にヤリのこした事って、コレか？）

　結局国を守る誇りといいながら”牡”としての欲望だけが最後の瞬間に考えることか！　と自嘲しているとドアが開いて銃口が見えた。光も音も、痛みすら感じずに意識がなくなった。

import sqlite3
import telegram
from telegram import InlineKeyboardButton, InlineKeyboardMarkup, Update
from telegram.ext import Updater, CommandHandler, CallbackQueryHandler, CallbackContext

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
bot = telegram.Bot(token=‘YOUR_BOT_TOKEN’)
API_TOKEN = ‘YOUR_API_TOKEN’

category_tables = {
    ‘Кроссовки’: ‘items’,
    ‘Верхняя одежда’: ‘items1’,
    ‘Аксессуары’: ‘items2’,
}

def start(update: Update, context: CallbackContext):
    keyboard = [
        [InlineKeyboardButton(category, callback_data=category) for category in category_tables]
    ]
    reply_markup = InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard)
    if update.message:
        update.message.reply_text(‘Выберите категорию товара:’, reply_markup=reply_markup)
    else:
        query = update.callback_query
        query.answer()
        query.edit_message_text(‘Выберите категорию товара:’, reply_markup=reply_markup)

def category_handler(update: Update, context: CallbackContext):
    query = update.callback_query
    category = query.data
    table = category_tables[category]
    conn = sqlite3.connect(‘kross.db’)
    c = conn.cursor()
    c.execute(f’SELECT name FROM {table}‘)
    items = c.fetchall()
    keyboard = [
        [InlineKeyboardButton(items[i][0], callback_data=f’{table}{i}‘) for i in range(min(4, len(items)))]
    ]
    if len(items) > 4:
        keyboard.append([
            InlineKeyboardButton(‘Вперед’, callback_data=f’next{table}0_4’)
        ])
    reply_markup = InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard)
    query.answer()
    query.edit_message_text(f’Выберите товар ({category}):‘, reply_markup=reply_markup)

def change_page(update: Update, context: CallbackContext):
    query = update.callback_query
    data = query.data.split(’ ‘)
    action = data[0]
    table = data[1]
    start_index = int(data[2])
    end_index = int(data[3])
    conn = sqlite3.connect(‘kross.db’)
    c = conn.cursor()
    c.execute(f’SELECT name FROM {table}’)
    items = c.fetchall()
    prev_start = max(0, start_index - 4)
    prev_end = start_index
    next_start = end_index
    next_end = min(end_index + 4, len(items))
    if action == ‘next’:
        start_index = next_start
        end_index = next_end

def back_button_handler(update: Update, context: CallbackContext):
    query = update.callback_query
    table = query.data.split(‘‘)[1]

    for category, tbl in category_tables.items():
        if tbl == table:
            query.data = category
            category_handler(update, context)
            break

def main():
    updater = Updater(API_TOKEN)

    dp = updater.dispatcher
    dp.add_handler(CommandHandler(‘start’, start))
    for tbl in category_tables.values():
        dp.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(show_product, pattern=f’^{tbl}\d+‘))
    dp.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(change_page, pattern=’^(prev|next)[a-zA-Z0-9]+‘))
    dp.add_handler(CallbackQueryHandler(back_button_handler, pattern=’^back[a-zA-Z0-9]+’))
    updater.start_polling()
    updater.idle()

if name == ‘main’:
    main()

Attachment 1: Policy and Procedure:
Policies:
Effective food safety practices:
• reflect the Food Safety Standards for Australia in relation to safety practices, premises
and equipment standards;
• reinforce consistent food safety practices in the service;
• reduce the risk of potential food-borne illnesses;
• identify potentially hazardous foods;
• are regularly reviewed; and
• comply with legislative requirements whilst maintaining a flexible approach to meet
best practice.
• Wash hands before food preparation
• Cleaning food preparation area before, during and after use.
• Using colour-coded chopping boards in order to prevent cross contamination of raw
food.
• Avoiding the contamination of one work area to another by having specific cleaning
implements for a specific area.
• Ensuring food is always served in a hygienic way for example, washing hands prior to
serving
• food, using tongs and serving utensils.
• Clean tables with detergent and warm water and dry after meal times.
Procedures:
• Don’t leave perishable foods in the temperature danger zone for longer than 2 hours.
• Keep cold food in a fridge, freezer, below 5°C until you are ready to cook or serve, eg if you are
serving salads keep them in the fridge until ready to serve.
• Keep hot food in an oven or on a stove, above 60 °C until you are ready to serve.
• Never defrost hazardous foods on the bench top. Foods should be defrosted overnight in the
fridge or in the microwave.
• Use a thermometer to make sure your fridge is below 5°C
• Don’t overload refrigerators, as this reduces cooling efficiency.
• Store dry foods in sealed, air-tight containers.
• Any food removed from its original container must be stored in a container with the used by date
of the food written on it.
• Ensure the food storage area is well cleaned, ventilated, dry, pest free and not in direct sunlight.
• Prevent pests by cleaning spills as quickly as possible and removing garbage/waste frequently.
• All foods are wrapped, covered, dated (used by date and open date) and labeled.
• Store foods on shelves, never on the floor.
• Store raw and cooked foods separately. Never store raw foods on top of cooked foods as juices
may drip down and contaminate the cooked food.
• Store food once it has sufficiently cooled down. Foods cool quicker in smaller, shallow containers.
• Fridges and freezers need to be cleaned regularly and fridge door seals checked to be in good
repair.
• The operating temperature of the fridge and freezer need to be checked regularly and a record
kept of this.

Another earth shaking step of the colossal equine smashes a tree to splinter under the boulder sized hoof of his front leg. He looks around with a placid gaze on his eyes and then lowers his enormous equine head toward some of the trees. His horse' lips opens and closes around the crowns of some trees and with sharp noises of broken wood he chews them as if they were mere blade of grass.     
Then, after that little snack, he slowly moves forward, his hooves crashing through the surface of the water with thunderous splashings and getting in deeper water his belly and muscular shoulder brutally enter the lake. The jaguar struggles against the waves and swirls caused by the hundred of tons of immense equine body as it is making the water more agitated than any tempest the lake could have known. But the stallion doesn't notice the tiny jaguar trashing in the water yet and simply enjoys his bath, his horse tail swaying nonchalantly. 
Getting submerse several meters deep at several times by the brutal swirls and waves caused by the mere movement of the gigantic herbivore the jaguar is helplessly struggling, his powerful and brawny muscles being no match against the heavy turbulence caused by any of the casual movements of the massive meaty beast.
But, as he is looking around peacefully, the colossal draft horse notices the frantic movement of the creature, diminutive in comparison of his looming and massively powerful form.
The jaguar roars in total fear as he sees the humongous titan looming head turning in his precise direction and one of his huge eyes staring at him he struggles against the still incredibly turbulent water. He attempts to swim away his strong muscles doing their best to make him reach the more distance he can from the proximity with that colossus. His thick greyish horse lips ready to close.

make a title for this essay:The drug trade has long been in the spot-light in both society and the realm of entertainment media. Throughout history, countless movies and television shows have aimed to capture the engrossing nature and seductive allure of this illicit world. In film and television, the drug dealer is often portrayed as a significant character, embodying themes such as ambition, greed, power, betrayal, and loss. The television series Breaking Bad, Euphoria, Snowfall and the film Scarface serve as perfect examples of the realities faced by drug dealers, encapsulating their trajectory from humble beginnings to their “golden age” and the subsequent tragic downfall. By examining the journeys of these characters, entertainment media provides a compelling narrative that exposes the harsh realities of the drug trade. 
Entertainment media has accurately portrayed the gradual rise of characters embarking on the path of drug dealing, presenting captivating narratives that explore the complex motivations, opportunities, and consequences that accompany their journeys. One notable illustration of this can be found in the cinematic masterpiece “Scarface,” which tells the transformative journey of Tony Montana, a Cuban immigrant driven by an insatiable ambition for wealth and power, who rises to become a lynchpin drug lord in Miami (De Palma). Factors contributing to Tony’s entrance into the drug trade include his desire to escape poverty, a brutal background shaped by the harsh realities of Cuba, and the magnitude of the opportunities offered by the drug trade. For instance, during the infamous chainsaw scene at the beginning of the film, Tony shows his ruthless resolve in order to break into the drug business, which eventually leads him to become part of Frank Lopez’s organization. Similarly, the critically acclaimed television series “Breaking Bad” introduces viewers into the life of Walter White, a seemingly ordinary high school chemistry teacher who, faced with a terminal cancer diagnosis and financial struggles, succumbs to the lure of the drug trade in an effort to secure his family’s future (Gilligan). Walter’s transformation from a mild-mannered educator to the notorious alter ego, Heisenberg, is demonstrated by a series of events such as his initial decision to cook methamphetamine with his former student, Jesse Pinkman, his manipulation of the drug kingpin Gustavo Fring, and his eventual rise in power as a drug lord. Additionally, the television series “Snowfall” provides us with an intriguing portrayal of the ascent of drug dealers, primarily focusing on the character of Franklin Saint (Singleton). “Snowfall” offers a thought-provoking narrative that highlights the interconnectiveness of circumstances, ambition, and personal choices as Franklin navigates his way from a small-time dealer to an unstoppable force within the drug trade. Raised in a low-income Los Angeles neighborhood, Franklin’s ambitions and determination lead him to seek opportunities outside the familiar environment, propelled by his entrepreneurial spirit, an influential drug supplier, and the timely emergence of crack cocaine. Specifically, early in the series, Franklin encounters business hardships with the sale of marijuana, leading him to be introduced to Avi Drexler, an Israeli cocaine dealer who supplies Franklin with the drugs necessary for his entry into the crack cocaine trade. Furthermore, Franklin’s story delves into the systemic issues, such as racial inequality and economic disparities, that cause him to be engulfed by the drug trade despite his intelligence and potential for success elsewhere. These shows and films shed light on the multifaceted nature of the initial ascent of drug dealers and the intricate web of factors that contribute to their eventual success. By presenting dynamic characters with complex motivations and circumstances, these works of fiction effectively present accurate representations of how people may end up in the drug trade, ultimately drawing attention to the need for addressing these underlying issues.
	Often times, the neverending pursuit of wealth, dominance, and influence shapes the stories of characters involved in the drug trade, offering glimpses into the intoxicating lifestyles and intricate dynamics of those entangled in this dangerous world. “Scarface” captures Tony Montana’s rise from rags to riches, where he revels in the unrestricted wealth, copious amounts of drugs, and his social status acquired through his engagement in the drug trade. For example, the infamous “Money, Power, Women” scene, where Tony is immersed in luxury, illustrates how the film captures the metamorphosis of an unremarkable individual into a towering figure intoxicated by the spoils of triumph. The television series “Euphoria” also provides a unique perspective on the enticement of drug dealing – Fez, a pivotal character in the show, serves as an example of the intricate power dynamics at play within the drug trade. Fez’s decision to protect Rue, the protagonist, and his subsequent confrontations with dangerous adversaries like Mouse exemplify the temptations, risks, and loyalties associated with his chosen path in drug dealing. Furthermore, “Snowfall” offers another captivating depiction of intricate power dynamics through Franklin Saint’s journey through the underworld, as he navigates relationships with his family, law enforcement, and rival drug dealers. Events like Franklin’s manipulation of Officer Andre Wright and his partnership with his cunning aunt, Louie, display the appeal, risks, and power dynamics at play. The series sheds light on the delicate balance between trust and betrayal, along with the accumulation of wealth and the lavish lifestyles it affords. However, as most of these stories unfold, the facade of wealth and power gradually falls to reveal a darker reality of personal and moral degradation, as evidenced by Tony’s eventual downfall in “Scarface,” Fez’s increasing vulnerability in “Euphoria,” and Franklin’s experience of emotional turmoil and near-death experiences in “Snowfall.”
Media portrayals accurately reflect the inevitable tragic downfall of drug dealers through their loss of power, relationships, and ultimately their lives, delving into the gripping and somber realities that unfold when the pursuit of wealth and dominance takes a devastating toll on those involved. A notable depiction is “Scarface,” where Tony Montana, after making a multitude of enemies, including with Sosa, a powerful Bolivian drug lord, experiences a bloody shootout in the film’s final scene; his lavish mansion is overtaken by a small army of gunmen who ultimately end his life, effectively portraying the unraveling of Tony’s empire, and showcasing the catastrophic consequences of his actions. In “Breaking Bad,” the tragic end of Walter White occurs as he becomes consumed by power and wealth – his descent into darkness leads to the destruction of his family, the loss of his relationships, and ultimately his own life. Notable events that contribute to Walter’s downfall include the poisoning of a child to manipulate Jesse, the death of his brother-in-law Hank in a desert shootout with a white supremacist gang, and the climactic battle in the gang’s compound, which results in Walter’s fatal injury as he activates an automated machine gun he installed in the trunk of his car. The series masterfully sets up the devastating consequences that befall Walter, demonstrating the profound personal costs that come with the pursuit of forbidden glory. In “Snowfall,” as Franklin Saint dives deeper into the underworld, he experiences murders and violence, such as the death of his friend Kevin, who he coerces into killing a rival gang member, his own near-fatal shooting orchestrated by rival drug dealer Manboy, and the tumultuous relationship with his drug-addicted father, Alton, who becomes a liability and a potential informant due to his relationship with investigative reporter Irene Abe. Haunted by the violence and loss he encounters, Franklin becomes increasingly torn between loyalty to his family and the desire to maintain his criminal empire. As he faces these challenges and the consequences of his decisions, his ability to maintain control over his life, sanity, and business crumbles, leaving him questioning his own morality and the future of his operation. In summary, these media portrayals capture the tragic downfall and demise of drug dealers, shedding light on the loss of power, relationships, and ultimately lives. From Tony Montana’s blood-soaked end in “Scarface” to Walter White’s tragic finish in “Breaking Bad,” and Franklin Saint’s encounters with violence and loss in “Snowfall,” these narratives provide a sobering reflection on the consequences faced by those who find themselves involved in the world of drug dealing.
Critics argue that entertainment media often exaggerate the rise, glory, and tragic downfall of drug dealers, leading to distorted perceptions of the drug trade. Evidence of this can be seen in the excessive violence portrayed in “Scarface,” where Tony Montana’s story culminates in a highly dramatized shootout with a small army of armed attackers storming his mansion. This iconic scene, characterized by the infamous line, “Say hello to my little friend,” accompanied by a torrent of bullets from a grenade launcher-equipped M16, represents an example of the extreme and likely unrealistic levels of violence in the film (Stone). Another instance can be found in the dramatic character arcs in “Euphoria.” The television series, while providing a unique perspective on drug dealing through characters like Fez, may not necessarily reflect the reality for most drug dealers. For example, Fez’s deep emotional connection with Rue, the show’s main character, his ability to operate his drug business relatively discreetly, and his dangerous confrontations with allies and rivals like Mouse and Nate may contribute to an overly dramatic and sensationalized portrayal of the drug trade (Levinson). While these works of fiction are undeniably engaging and thought-provoking, it is essential to recognize the potential embellishments and sensationalism present in such media portrayals of drug dealers and the drug trade.
While critics argue that media dramatizes the drug trade, it is important to acknowledge that numerous portrayals accurately reflect aspects of the rise, glory, and tragic downfalls faced by drug dealers, offering crucial insights into the harsh reality of the drug trade. The critically acclaimed series “Breaking Bad” explores the character of Walter White, a high school chemistry teacher who turns to manufacturing methamphetamine to support his family after being diagnosed with terminal lung cancer; throughout the series, Walter White’s transformation is meticulously crafted, showcasing his moral dilemmas, growing hubris, and eventual descent into darkness, and the show highlights the cost of his engagement in the drug trade, emphasizing the collateral damage Walter inflicts on his loved ones, including the death of his brother-in-law and the disintegration of his family, offering a realistic and sobering perspective on the personal consequences of becoming involved in drug dealing (Gilligan). Furthermore, the television series “Snowfall,” created by John Singleton, delves into the origins of the crack cocaine epidemic in the early 1980s Los Angeles, following the story of Franklin Saint, an ambitious drug dealer grappling with the impact of his actions on himself, his family, and his community; “Snowfall” provides an authentic perspective on the entrenchment of the drug trade in marginalized, low-income communities and how systemic issues perpetuate cycles of addiction, violence, and loss, specifically highlighting the complicity of government agencies in fueling the crack epidemic, as exemplified by the character of CIA operative, Teddy McDonald, who facilitates the drug trade to fund anti-Communist rebel groups in Latin America (Singleton, 2017). In conclusion, although some entertainment media may indeed exaggerate certain elements of the drug trade, numerous portrayals provide accurate depictions of the harsh realities faced by drug dealers and the communities affected by the drug trade, and by scrutinizing the careful character development and attention to detail in TV series like “Breaking Bad” and “Snowfall,” audiences can develop a more comprehensive and informed understanding of the multifaceted and destructive world of drug dealing, thereby fostering a better understanding of the insidious effects of the drug trade at both personal and societal levels and serving an essential role in educating viewers on the consequences of engaging in such illicit activities.
Real-life accounts of drug dealers, as documented in secondary sources, support the accuracy and depth of the rise, glory, and tragic downfall portrayed in entertainment media, strengthening the argument that many media portrayals offer important insights into the reality of the drug trade. For instance, the documentary “Drug Lords: The Rise and Fall of El Chapo” provides an in-depth look into the life, criminal career, and eventual takedown of the notorious drug lord Joaquín “El Chapo” Guzmán, revealing the complexity of his criminal empire, the Sinaloa Cartel, and his violent methods - offering a parallel to fictional portrayals of drug dealers and validating the authenticity of shows like “Breaking Bad” and “Snowfall” (Netflix). Additionally, “Crack in the System” delves into the life of “Freeway” Rick Ross, chronicling his journey from poverty to becoming a key figure in the American crack cocaine epidemic, illustrating the challenges Ross faced, such as social and economic disadvantages, the allure of wealth and power, and the eventual consequences of his actions, including a life sentence in prison, which was later reduced (Levin); this real-life example mirrors the challenges faced by the character Franklin Saint in “Snowfall”, further supporting the idea that entertainment media can accurately reflect the harsh realities of drug dealing. Moreover, “Pablo Escobar: Beyond Narcos” examines the life and criminal enterprises of the infamous drug lord, providing insight into the power dynamics, violence, and eventual downfall faced by such figures, delving into Escobar’s rise from a small-time smuggler to the leader of the powerful Medellín Cartel, detailing the violent conflicts, principles of “plata o plomo” (silver or lead), and the devastating effects of his empire on Colombia (Hill); similar to the dramatic character arcs in “Euphoria” and the violence portrayed in “Scarface”, real-life accounts like Escobar’s story confirm that even the most sensationalized aspects of entertainment media can be grounded in the real experiences of drug dealers. These secondary sources provide compelling evidence that many entertainment media depictions of drug dealers and the drug trade are rooted in reality, highlighting the relevance and importance of such portrayals in raising awareness and understanding of the complexities and consequences associated with drug dealing; by analyzing these sources alongside works of fiction, audiences can develop a comprehensive and informed perspective on the multifaceted and destructive world of drug dealing, fostering a better understanding of its insidious effects at both personal and societal levels.
In conclusion, entertainment media has played a significant role in portraying the intricate world of the drug trade, often accurately capturing the realities faced by drug dealers. Through the examination of television series like Breaking Bad, Euphoria, and Snowfall, as well as the film Scarface, the audience is presented with enthralling narratives that expose the harsh realities and complex dynamics of the drug trade. These portrayals not only provide cautionary tales on the consequences faced by those involved but also serve as valuable tools in understanding the underlying motivations, challenges, and power struggles within this illicit world. Although critics argue that some portrayals may be exaggerated or sensationalized, real-life accounts documented in secondary sources support the argument that many media portrayals offer important insights into the reality of the drug trade. By analyzing these sources alongside works of fiction, audiences can develop a comprehensive and informed perspective that helps foster a better understanding of the insidious effects of drug dealing at both personal and societal levels.

read this article by angshuman - From Linear to Circular for Sustainable Packaging Inks
The traditional life cycle of packaging results in needless levels of emissions and waste. This is because a linear economy goes only one way. Products and resources are created, used and then become waste which gets throw out. 
In contrast, a Circular Economy is based on economic development decoupled from the use of finite resources, allowing for human well-being while respecting the natural boundaries of our planet. 
In the packaging industry, a Circular Economy is achieved by 
1.	Reducing – The first step is to reduce the use of materials, especially plastic, where possible. We can do so by eliminating packaging structures not needed for the functionality of packaging or by using renewable materials.
2.	Reusing – If we can not sensibly reduce the material we use, we should aim to reuse the packaging as often as possible. This moves packaging from single-use consumable goods to durable goods.   
3.	Recycling – The only acceptable end-use scenario in a Circular Economy is recycling. This keeps the material and the economic value in the system.

Siegwerk leads the way towards a Circular Economy. 
Siegwerk has established itself as the market leader for safe and sustainable packaging inks and coatings, pioneering solutions to shift from a wasteful linear packaging model to a circular model predicated on the concepts of reducing, reusing and recycling packaging. 
Sustainability is central to its business ambitions, and is underpinned by a sustainable business initiative, called HorizonNOW. This initiative has set bold targets to be achieved by 2025 in the areas of People and Communities, Operations and Supply Chain, Product Safety and Responsibility and Circular Economy. In terms of Circular Economy, our aim is to ensure that 75% of all products and services enable reusable, renewable or recyclable packaging.  
“A circular economy is a systemic approach to economic development designed to benefit businesses, society, and the environment. In order to preserve the natural resources for future generations, we all need to adopt Circular Economy practices in our everyday life, being it professional or personnel,” explains Shailendra Nagotkar, Head of Application Technology Flexible Packaging for Siegwerk India.
Siegwerk uses its expertise in inks and coatings to develop tailor-made solutions to meet customer needs, and those needs are increasingly related to circularity and sustainability. Just a few of the solutions Siegwerk has developed include:
1.	De-Inking 
There is increased awareness of the need to recycle packaging to create the materials needed for new packaging.
However, current recyclate quality is typically poor. This is due to the unpleasant visual appearance or odor of different types of recyclates after extrusion, which can be related to ink degrading and remaining in the recyclates. This unfortunately enforces downcycling. Siegwerk’s de-inking and delamination technology enables the creation of high-quality recyclates.
The de-inking and delamination primer creates a printable layer sensitive to an industrial washing progress. Inks and coatings are removed quickly and effectively, leaving clean separated plastic layers. 
These remaining high quality recyclates can be used in new packaging materials. This technology is compatible with a wide variety of packaging structures, and packaging specifications remain unchanged. 
Most importantly, use of the de-inking and delamination technology aids in achieving 100% recyclability, an essential component in enabling the Circular Economy

A practical example of this technology can be seen in deinking of shrink sleeves. Washable crystallizable PET shrink sleeves are invaluable in increasing the yield in PET bottle-to-bottle recycling. Working in partnership with other companies in the supply chain, Siegwerk developed washable shrink sleeves based on crystallizable PET (cPET) as film printed with specially developed washable inks and primer solutions. In this way both the bottle and the shrink sleeve can go through the recycling process without the need for separation. 
Siegwerk’s deinking technology has received recognition from the Association of Plastic Recyclers (APR). 

2.	Barrier Coatings for Paper and Board
Siegwerk‘s new portfolio of UNILAC barrier coatings for paper and board includes a range of products that repel water and water vapor, oils, and greases. These barrier coatings are available and produced using natural resins and renewable raw materials whenever possible. Importantly, paper and board coated with these barrier coatings are typically repulpable, recyclable, and compostable, thereby giving paper and paperboard packaging producers the confidence that their packaging has a variety of end of life solutions, minimizing their impact in case of leakage into the environment (littering).
Siegwerk offers a range of barrier coating formulations to accommodate a variety of Paper & Board packaging products, including paper cups, fast food wrappers, and corrugated boxes, meeting, of course, the functional needs of the paper such as printability, flexibility, and gluability.
3.	Paperization
There is growing interest in switching from plastic to paper-based packaging, partly because paper packaging can be more circular in certain circumstances. But there are challenges to making the switch.  Paper packaging can be limited in scope, which is unfortunate because it has a well-established waste and recycling stream. There is therefore a need to facilitate a wider packaging paperization scope to utilize already existing waste streams. There is a challenge in reducing shelf life limitations when going away from film-based structures. And when switching to paper, one must ensure compliance to recycling streams by avoiding unwanted/disrupting materials like PVC. Siegwerk makes this transition possible through solutions such as printable barrier coatings to improve grease, aroma and water vapor resistance, as well as Cobb value reduction coating to maintain the package structure even in moist atmospheres. These coatings replace the function usually served by plastic.

As the need for circular packaging solutions grows, so too does Siegwerk’s efforts to develop innovative solutions to meet unique needs. Siegwerk’s ambition to build a truly sustainable business makes the company an ideal partner for customers seeking to realize their own sustainability targets.

请帮我翻译这段话成英文，并尽量使用学术口吻。腺垂体作为身体的代谢调节中枢，主要包括下丘脑-垂体-性腺（HPG）、下丘脑-垂体-甲状腺（HPT）和下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺（HPA）轴[]。它们通过分泌多种细胞因子、生长因子和受体等对人体内各组织器官产生影响。其中，HPG轴在人体内主要调节性别发育、精子发生、卵子成熟等过程，有助于第二性特征的发育和维持；HPT轴则主要调节体内甲状腺激素含量，进而调节新陈代谢；而HPA轴则主要参与控制应激和与消化，心情、情绪等多种身体活动。腺垂体分泌的激素在糖尿病、动脉粥样硬化、阿尔茨海默病等代谢性疾病的发生发展中发挥病理作用[]。近几十年来，一个激动人心的发现就是腺垂体产生的多种激素──从肾上腺轴激素，到性腺轴激素直至甲状腺轴激素──均与MAFLD进展有密切关系。例如生长激素和促性激素可以影响脂肪代谢和胰岛素敏感度等，从而影响MAFLD的发展[]。促甲状腺激素和促肾上腺皮质激素可能会调节脂肪氧化和炎症反应[]。激素失衡可能是MAFLD发生发展的重要因素之一。 
最近的研究表明，上游垂体刺激素对MAFLD具有直接作用。据报道，上游垂体刺激素可以通过激活肝脂代谢和炎症途径，促进肝脂合成，并增加血清胆固醇和三酰甘油水平。此外，上游垂体刺激素还可以通过激活NF-κB和TNF-α途径，诱导肝细胞凋亡和炎症反应，导致肝脏纤维化和炎症。因此，上游垂体刺激素可能成为MAFLD治疗的新靶点[]。因此，本文就近年来腺垂体激素在MAFLD发生发展中的作用进行了综述。

resumir en tres parrafos: Lo primero que debe aclararse es la distinción entre competencia lingüística y actuación lingüística. La competencia corresponde a la capacidad que tiene un hablante-oyente idealizado para asociar sonidos y significados conforme a reglas inconscientes y automáticas. La actuación, o ejecución lingüística, corresponde a la interpretación y comprensión de oraciones de acuerdo con la competencia, pero regulándose además a partir de principios extralingüísticos, como las restricciones de la memoria, e incluso las creencias (Chomsky, 1970, 1992). Al respecto es importante aclarar que la aceptabilidad de una oración no es equivalente a su gramaticalidad puesto que la aceptabilidad de una frase consiste en que pueda ser usada con naturalidad en un grupo social, y su gramaticalidad en la adecuación que presente a reglas inconscientes que relacionan sonidos con significados (Chomsky, 1978). Un aspecto que resulta interesante de la gramática generativa, aunque también algo inquietante, es que está referida totalmente a hablantes-oyentes idealizados, los cuales serían una especie de hablante oyente que conoce el lenguaje a la perfección y que nunca comete errores, debido a que no se ve afectado por limitaciones o distracciones del contexto (Hierro, 1976; véase Chomsky, 1992, como ejemplo). Ahora bien, sea lo que fuere un hablante-oyente idealizado, es claro que el programa de investigación de Chomsky no se centra en el uso que del lenguaje hacen personas en particular sino en un determinado nivel abstracto racional que está exento de influencias extramentales, que ciertamente no son desconocidas por el autor, pero que no se consideran relevantes (Chomsky, 1998; Salvat Editores, 1975). Por otra parte, la explicación de las condiciones del lenguaje propuesta por Chomsky es una teoría de la competencia y no de la actuación, es decir, no explica la producción ni la percepción del lenguaje en circunstancias cotidianas sino en estados abstractos, ideales. Por lo tanto los procesos de comprensión y producción online (en tiempo y circunstancias reales) no ocurren necesariamente en el orden que se ha propuesto en el marco de la gramática generativa (Chomsky, 1992). En consecuencia, concluye el lingüista (Chomsky) que usar su teoría para explicar la producción y percepción del lenguaje online equivaldría a decir que el hablante elige las características de la oración (sintaxis) antes de elegir de qué va a hablar (léxico). De esta suerte, no es viable ni lógico explicar el funcionamiento cotidiano del lenguaje en función de la gramática generativa. Ha de anotarse también que para Chomsky la razón de la existencia del lenguaje en los humanos no es permitir la comunicación sino permitir la creación y expresión del pensamiento (Salvat Editores, 1975). La expresión del pensamiento, puntualiza el lingüista, es una necesidad humana a la cual responde la aparición del lenguaje, si aparte de eso podemos comunicar a alguien nuestros pensamientos mediante la lengua, tanto mejor. Al respecto, estima el filósofo de la mente John Searle que el propósito del lenguaje es la comunicación, así como el propósito del corazón es bombear sangre, “in both cases it is possible to study the structure independently of function but pointless and perverse to do so, since structure and function so obviously interact” (Searle, 1972, sección III, párr. 4).

Think a title for :Joe always knew that he was apart of a very elite circle in LA. He knew that once upon a time he had brushed shoulders with the most powerful of business people, socialites and personalities. Before he had left for Kenya, he had still been on every VVIP exclusive list despite only attending ones he was commanded to by David or his distant relatives who still sat on IDM Inc boards. 

So it should not have been a surprise when he walked into an upscale Vietnamese restaurant in one of the most exclusive districts in LA, and came face to face with Robert Cummings. The same Robert Cummings who would endlessly stare at him at every event they both happened to attend despite the fact that he would attend with David looming over him, his Alpha pheromones warning Robert that he would destroy him if he ever looked at something that belonged to David. 

The same Robert who would “coincidentally” run into him at the hospital he worked at and would tell him he had pretty eyes for an unpresented Alpha. Joseph knew that the older man had some sort of a crush on him in the past, and as the man sat himself down at Joe’s table at the restaurant, Joe could only hope that he’d put those feelings behind him or that they would allow Joe to get a better rate for the medicines he was seeking. 

“Ah, the Prodigal unpresented Alpha Joseph Iverson.” Robert greeted, his chubby cheeks pulling into a friendly smile. 

Schooling his features, Joe stood up and extended his hand in greeting and giving Robert’s a firm shake despite feeling an uncomfortable feeling in his chest at the mention of his unpresented sub-gender. 

“Robert Cummings,” Joe laughed, pulling the man into a half hug before sitting down. “I had my suspicions that it was you, but this is a very pleasant surprise. How have you been?” 

“You know what it’s like here. The same shit, different year. How’s it going on the other side of the world. Living in a third world country is good look on you.” Robert commented, his eyes analyzing Joe’s newer and more mature features. 

He always thought that Joseph was gorgeous and would have made an amazing trophy husband but despite the fact that the younger had refused to marry his betrothed, he would never even look at the men in David’s circle – Robert included. 

Joe chuckled in response, the flush of pink on his ears the only indication of his embarrassment at the compliment. “You don’t look so bad yourself.” He muttered, smiling. 

Robert stood a little shorter than Joe, slightly rounder than the younger remembered, but he could see he was still a little fit. Probably from playing golf with his rich buddies. 

After catching himself staring for a moment too long, Robert’s brain kicked back into action. He cleared his throat, looking around for a server. “Are you hungry? You must try the Pho here. You’ll absolutely love it.” 

Smiling, Joe nodded, “After so much time abroad, I would love to have some Pho. It’s been too long.” 

After placing their orders and catching up briefly as Joe could manage, he steered the conversation to the purpose of the meeting. He wouldn’t get swept up in the conversation only to waste his time on a pathetic offer like the last one. 

“I received the list of the medicines you want, and I’d love to help. My company is doing well, and I think it would be prudent to give back to the community – even if said community is in Kenya.” Robert said decisively, leaning back in his seat. 

Joe nodded gratefully, “Pray tell.” Joe added jokingly, his eyes narrowing slightly in suspicion. “Ten years ago TeCum Pharmaceutical was a small company. I witnessed it near crash just before I returned to LA for residency. Now, it seems that you’re part of the top 6 companies in the States.”

Sighing in resignation, Robert nodded in concession. “You know then that there are people who poured into the business and assisted with more than just finance. I have a friend who helped me restore TeCum from the ground up. He still has a large influence on the company. I’m very grateful.” 

Joe analysed him, feeling a little bad for bringing up the company’s near bankruptcy. “I am too. Without it, you wouldn’t be able to assist so many people in Kenya. I’m grateful for your offer to help, Robert.” 

Robert gave him a small smile, “How many medicines are we talking and how much of a discount are you looking for?” 

Handing him the typed out compilation and description, Joseph held his breath as Robert looked it over, nodding in approval. 

“We have enough of the requested stock of about 25 of these. However, the other 7 would require a month or two to finalize the shipment to ensure you have enough quantities and back up.” Robert nodded, writing notes on the copy Joe had handed him. 

Joe smiled gratefully, his heart leaping with joy at being able to complete his mission in less than the 3 months allocated. “Really? That is great. If we can push it to under a month or a month, it would be perfect. Then we can allocate less than 2 weeks to shipment to Kenya. What are we talking in terms of price. As you know, we don’t have a big budget.” 
“To be honest, the best I can do without board approval and the sanction of a major shareholder would be about 20%. It’s not cheap to produce and ship these medicines to USA.” 

Groaning softly, Joe’s shoulder’s dropped. “We actually need almost a 60% discount to account for the storage facilities that would need to be constructed in two different locations. Do you think I could talk to the shareholders about it, maybe we can swing more and get the rest from another company?” 

“Well, we would need a majority vote from shareholders on that amount. But we can try. Maybe speak to my friend – the shareholder. I’m supposed to visit him in a few minutes so you can tag along and maybe convince him? He would be your best shot.” 

“Yes. Yes – anything. Let’s go!” Joe cheered, before thinking about it. “But will he be okay with that? Won’t it put you an awkward position?”

Robert waved it off, chuckling, “Think of it as a gift to you.” He smiled at Joe, staring him deep in the eye. Joe ducked his head in discomfort, making Robert retreat from the boldness he’d just felt. “I- I mean, I truly envy the work you do. Making a difference. Nothing about profit.” He supplemented. 

“Ah, Thank you.” Joe mumbled. 

“Let’s go right now. I don’t want to be late.” 

Standing and walking to Robert’s own luxury vehicle and drove away in it, with Joe’s following close behind them. He watched the city center disappear and the suburbs coming into view, driving past very nice neighborhoods which housed the upper middle class, the upper class before reaching the neighborhood where one residence took up way more than some people could dream of. High walls and large expanses of greenery stretching far took Joe’s attention. 

The neighborhood familiar but not quite ringing a bell. He’d been to way too many parties in this neighborhood. As they were allowed access into a large estate, the trees on either side guiding their drive, Joe began to remember the residence. 

“This is my friend’s late father’s house. It belongs to the Marx’s youngest Alpha.” 

Joe kept his face neutral, the bitter feeling of betrayal rising up his throat. It was too late to turn back and he could feel the burn of Robert’s analytical gaze on him. 

Damn this man to hell. 

They walked into the recently renovated and re-designed mansion, the twist familiar to Joe’s soul as he remembered so many fights taking place in these very halls. His heart twisted with nerves, his conscious laughing at the predicament. 

He should have known. 

They approached a figure, tightly wrapped in a blanket on his shoulder, despite the fact that it wasn’t truly that cold yet. Sure winter was approaching but it was hardly even sweater season. His body didn’t seem familiar, but the neat trim of his hair was something that Joe had already memorized in his youth and the four years since they last saw each other hadn’t erased the way his haircut emphasized his neck. A neck that Joe had been expected to bite in claim. 


“Hello, David.” Joe forced himself to say politely.

Robert excused himself from the room silently. He had known that there was nothing more to discuss because he’d done what David had instructed him to do. Although he was curious how this would play out, he knew better than to test David’s patience or Joe’s kindness. 

Joe and David didn’t even acknowledge Robert’s exit, instead focusing on each other. The emotions between the two running high. One knowing more than the other but knowing his intended was likely hurting, refrained from commenting on how the years had treated him.

“Am I still David?” David responded, voice light only breaking the silence as the tea pot was placed on the table between them before the staff scurried away, motioning for Joe to take a seat. Without breaking eye contact, Joe sat down across from him. 

“Wow, Alpha David. I can’t even conduct business without running into you. How many enterprises have you bought in this city? Should I expect to run into you whenever I try and conduct business?” 

Unsurprised and unimpressed, David rolled his eyes and decided to pour them some special Chinese medicinal tea. “How about you just try this tea and keep civil, intended?” David grumbled, pouring the tea without letting Joe get another word in. 

Taking a calming breath in, Joseph put the puzzle pieces together as he regarded David unsurprised and monotonous response to his presence. Of course David had put all this together to bring him to his knees begging for held. Bastard. 

“You made Robert give John that info on purpose didn’t you?” 

Scoffing and rolling his eyes as he took a sip of tea, “You contacted him first, didn’t you? I haven’t been interested in the pharmaceutical company in too long.” He replied calmly, letting his eyes glow red in warning. 

Joe wasn’t stupid. He knew David was powerful enough to know when he landed. He knew that he didn’t contact him on purpose. He probably set this whole thing up. Stubbornly, he took a sip of tea, letting David’s words wash over him. He had contacted Robert first. He was the one who made the move first. Joe had known the risk when he contacted people from his old life. 
 
“Let’s talk business then. What will it take for you to give me the discount we need for our DWB mission? Name your price.” Joe relented.

(I awoke in a strange-looking highland covered with coral, but there was no sign of anyone - not even my fellow Velociraptors. This definitely isn’t Isla Nublar…)

Blue: “Hello?! Charlie?! Echo?! Delta?! You guys out there?!”

(I started to hear footsteps - but they didn’t belong to any kind of human or dinosaur I knew.)

Legiana: “Another low-lander? What are YOU doing here on MY nest?”

(I was shocked as to what I was looking at. But I started to wonder where the Velociraptor paddock was, and why this place looked like something straight out of a Mosasaurus exhibit.)

Blue: “I’m sorry, I don’t know where I am. I was trying to find the Velociraptor paddock. Have you heard of it?”

Legiana: “Velociraptor? Never heard of it. But if you’re lost, perhaps I can help you. This is the Coral Highlands, home to the flying wyverns. You must have come from someplace far away.”

(Me and Legiana started walking, talking away about each other’s world and how they differ. But suddenly, a roar can be heard coming from far away.)

Blue: “What was that?”

Legiana: “It’s dangerous to stay here. That was the roar of the abyssal elder dragon. We must go, now!”

(I followed Legiana, trying to keep up with her impressive wingspan. But as we make a turn, we find ourselves face to face with the abyssal elder dragon. She has aspects of manta rays, deep sea fish, and jellyfish. Her massive wings are colored black on top and a light blue on the underside, with rainbow luminescence that pulses constantly. Her head is red and blue with the same pulsing luminescence. She also has multiple long whiskers on the lower jaw.)

Blue: “What is that thing?!”

Legiana: “That is Namielle, the abyssal elder dragon. It’s said that she can control water and lightning with ease. We need to get out of here!”

(I followed Legiana as we flew away from Namielle. It was the most exhilarating flight I had ever experienced. We soared over coral peaks, dodged geysers, and even narrowly avoided being hit by lightning bolts.)

Blue: “This place is incredible! I have never seen anything like it!”

Legiana: “Yes, the Coral Highlands are a wonder to behold. But they are also filled with danger. You must be careful if you ever plan to return.”

(I nodded in agreement as we finally landed on a small cliff overlooking the ocean. Legiana turned to me and nodded.)

Legiana: “You’ll be safe here. I must return to my nest. Farewell.”

(I watched as Legiana flew away, disappearing into the clouds. It was then that I realized that I needed to find a way back to Isla Nublar and my fellow Velociraptors. But for now, I had a whole new world to explore. I started to wonder what’s beneath all this coral, and saw a cavern full of bones and corpses. It was so filthy that I almost threw up.)

Blue: “What in the world… what could have caused all of this destruction?”

(As I walked closer, I noticed that the bones and corpses were not from any of the dinosaurs I knew back on Isla Nublar. They were the bones of creatures I have never seen before - with sharp teeth, large claws, and scales tougher than any dinosaur I knew.)

Blue: “What kind of monsters were fighting down here?”

(As I continued to explore, I started to notice strange symbols etched into the walls of the cavern. They resembled ancient languages and drawings, but I couldn’t understand them. Suddenly, I was surrounded by small, cobra-like dog things.)

Blue: “What?! What are these things?! Get away from me!”

(The small creatures circled around me in a threatening manner, their tails raised and their fangs bared. I quickly realized that I needed to defend myself.)

Blue: “Alright, if you want to fight, then let’s fight!”

(I lunged at one of the creatures, using my sharp claws to swipe at it. The creature dodged out of the way and retaliated with a quick bite, narrowly missing me. I could feel the adrenaline pumping through my veins as I continued to dodge and attack.)

Blue: “Come on, is that all you’ve got?!”

(I fought them off as best as I could, but more just kept coming. Then, I heard a cobra-like hissing sound.)
